biography.plain_text: Ralf Schumacher is a German former Formula One driver who won six Grands Prix with Williams and built substantial wealth through racing. Raised around his parents' kart track in Kerpen, he benefited from brother Michael's reputation when entering Opel's Formula Three team. He later became a broadcaster and property investor.

long_biography.plain_text:
Former racing driver Ralf Schumacher bought the Cape Town hotel Villa Coloniale after staying there with a friend who owned it. Property had already become a separate business: he bought, renovated and sold buildings, with large companies among his long-term tenants. He distinguished investments chosen for rental income from those bought for future appreciation.

His wine label grew from a search for bottles to serve in his restaurant. After tasting a Slovenian Ribolla Gialla, he began collaborating with the Klet Brda cooperative on Schumacher Selection. He took part in grape harvesting, while the cooperative's specialists made and matured the wines in the historic de Baguer cellar.
